description: This Java source file defines the ActiveNotificationsFragment class, a fragment that manages and displays active notifications within an Android application. It includes methods for creating notifications, updating notification summaries, and tracking the number of active notifications.

classes.name: ActiveNotificationsFragment
classes.description: A fragment that manages active notifications, allowing users to add notifications, update summaries, and display the current count of notifications.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the notification count when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes notification manager, UI elements, and sets up button click listeners.

methods.name: addNotificationAndUpdateSummaries
methods.description: Creates and posts a new notification, then updates notification summaries and count.

methods.name: updateNotificationSummary
methods.description: Adds, updates, or removes the notification summary based on active notifications.

methods.name: updateNumberOfNotifications
methods.description: Displays the current number of active notifications.

methods.name: getNewNotificationId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for new notifications.

methods.name: getNumberOfNotifications
methods.description: Returns the count of active notifications, excluding the summary notification.
